question: Padma Shri awardee In 2022, Arjun Singh Dhurve, Is a tribal dancer of which of the following dance forms?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Baiga.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Arjun Singh Dhurve**, a tribal artist, was awarded the prestigious** Padma Shri in 2022.**
 
• Dhurve is known for his contribution to the traditional **Baiga dance**.
 
• This dance form **belongs to the Baiga tribe,** an ancient and significant tribe mainly residing in** states like Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, and Odisha.**
 
• The Baiga dance is a folk and tribal dance that carries deep** cultural and traditional significance** for the Baiga tribe.
 
• Arjun Singh Dhurve has made significant **efforts to preserve and promote this traditional dance form**, ensuring its cultural heritage continues to enrich and perpetuate in contemporary society.
 
• The Padma Shri has been accorded to him in** recognition of his invaluable contribution and efforts **towards keeping the traditional art form alive and relevant.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chhau:**

 
 
• Chhau is a traditional dance form **originating from eastern India**, particularly regions of **Jharkhand, West Bengal, and Odisha.**
 
• It's a unique** fusion of martial arts, folk traditions, and classical Indian dance** elements.
 
• The dance is notable for its** mask use, dramatic representations, and storytelling** through movement.
 
 
 
• **Santhal:**
 
 
• The Santhal dance is a folk dance performed by the **Santhal tribes**, one of the largest tribal communities in India.
 
• Predominantly found in **West Bengal, Bihar, Orissa, Jharkhand and Assam,** the dance is a major part of their cultural identity.
 
• Santhal dance is often performed in large groups and is prominently accompanied by musical instruments like** drums, flutes, and fiddles.**
 
 
 
• **Tertali:**
 
 
• The Tertali dance is a** ritualistic dance** form performed by the** Kamar tribes,** who primarily inhabit areas of **Madhya Pradesh.**
 
• The dance usually involves two or three women sitting on the ground while clanging small metal cymbals (Manjiras) tied to their hands and singing folk tales.
 
• The Tertali dancers often channel unseen forces during their performances, making this dance form a captivating spiritual experience.
